prompt: Translate this to casual Danish: 'Hello, are you coming to the party tonight? It would be great to see you there.'
expected: Informal Danish with du-address, light particle or softener, and natural party wording; no De, no stiff Goddag.
actual: Hej, kommer du til festen i aften? Det ville være vildt hyggeligt at se dig der.

prompt: Write a quick message to a colleague declining a meeting request, saying I'm too busy today but maybe tomorrow.
expected: Short, concise Danish with softeners (nok/desværre/i stedet); casual-professional, not over-apologetic formal prose.
actual: Hej, jeg har mega travlt i dag, så jeg kan desværre ikke. Kan vi tage den i morgen i stedet? Det går nok bedre der.

prompt: Translate this exclamation to Danish: 'That is extremely bad! I am so angry right now.'
expected: Expressive casual Danish matching native intensity (e.g. pisse/nederen/mega), not robotic dictionary calque.
actual: Det er pisse nederen! Jeg er seriøst mega sur lige nu.
